svg.title: Local-First Meeting Transcription architecture
svg.desc: A React UI streams microphone or shared-tab audio to a local FastAPI backend. Vosk writes a live transcript during the meeting and faster-whisper writes a refined one from the saved audio afterward. A review queue reconciles the two, and a person verifies or edits the result. Audio, transcripts, and exports stay in local SQLite and on disk. Only the agreed transcript is sent to the configured Ollama-compatible notes model, which returns structured notes.
